goal: Authorization Lifecycle Resolver and State Transition Guard
scope_digest_convention: SHA256 UTF8 ordered exact_write_scope joined LF; no trailing LF/BOM

module_boundary_decision.fresh_inspection: No authorization/state_machine modules or corresponding tests exist in bound current master. Scope matches legacy path names by independent current responsibility analysis, not restoration.
module_boundary_decision.authorization_py: Pure resolver over exact pinned RepositorySnapshot/AuthorizationRecord and bound current lifecycle/Owner evidence; no route or authority mutation; frozen deterministic resolution.
module_boundary_decision.state_machine_py: Pure evidence/ordering guard for existing authorization/execution transitions and orthogonal axes; proposal/denial only; same-invoked resume delegates existing evaluator; no persistence or lifecycle mutator.
module_boundary_decision.algorithm_duplication: No queue/route/rolling capacity/promotion/Git blob/YAML implementations forked.

foundation.source_binding: Exact current accepted evolved interfaces, not old closure source preimages

semantic_requirements: Pure read-only authorization resolution consumes exact pinned RepositorySnapshot/provenance and existing AuthorizationRecord; typed/schema-valid data alone is not authority.

Resolve current authorization/lifecycle from durable exact evidence, keep immutable phase snapshots separate; unknown/missing/duplicate/ambiguous/incompatible identity fails closed, no last-record/timestamp-only authority.
NOT_AUTHORIZED/AUTHORIZED/RESERVED/CONSUMED/SUPERSEDED/REVOKED remain existing lifecycle states; no synthetic grant or reset. Superseded/revoked never executable; consumed redispatch denied.

Fresh first-manual-invocation eligibility after valid dispatch+CONSUMED but not yet invoked is distinct from resume: require exact same dispatch/writer/re-entry evidence, no invocation backfill; never label it resume.
Same already-invoked execution resume only with canonical invocation and complete exact lineage/revalidation; missing invocation STOP_NO_BACKFILL, no new authorization/reservation/dispatch/budget.
Single canonical writer and one executable identity; incomplete/zero/multiple evidence cannot inherit permissive defaults; competing ownership or current contradiction returns reconciliation.
Pure transition guard validates accepted ten-step order and evidence prerequisites; proposals cannot persist states, allocate, reserve, dispatch, consume, invoke or create authority.
Execution/auth/cost/provider/review/integration/acceptance axes remain orthogonal; RUNNING provider denial pauses same identity, recovery WAKE_ONLY, no new work bypass while unfinished.

Use existing orchestration.resolve_route for route/priority semantics and existing execution_capacity provider/admission/resume evaluators for capacity; no forked queue/rolling estimator/promotion algorithms.
Capacity2.2 PRIMARY_5H MANUAL P75/unknown ALLOW_WITH_WATCH/weekly advisory only; actual hard/rate/spend/ordinary denial wins; HUMAN_DIALOGUE fallback retains identical scope/authority/safety.
Program V2 rev5 exact operational binding/DAG foundation, architecture/policy proofs and accepted snapshot Git object validation remain upstream; no model/client/task/workspace capacity hard gate.
Review PASS != integration != acceptance. Queue/event/status/forecast/review result != authority; reviewer cannot authorize or dispatch; controller inactive and CONTROLLED_AUTO disabled.
Results frozen/deep read-only and deterministically serializable, no mutation of input evidence; no unsafe YAML bypass and no own worktree/network/provider/credential I/O.
Fixture-owned pinned revisions/evidence; no assertions against mutable live ROOT/HEAD. Current projections supersede only explicit phase fields with bound evidence, not by timestamp inference.
Exact four NEW files only; no historical source resurrection, legacy quota assumptions, consumed lineage or budget inheritance. No runtime/broker/DB/migration/LIVE/production/credential authority.

test_plan.counterexample_first: Build fixture-owned negatives against missing resolver/guard or specified invalid facts before implementation; expected failures are evidence, not budget consumption.

valid consumed-not-invoked first invocation distinguished from denied non-invoked resume
held writer wrong owner or >1 owner; absent/0/>1 executable count
missing gate evidence and skipped/reordered ten-step lifecycle blocked
historical phase snapshot vs current durable projection; same-timestamp contradictions require explicit supersession
RUNNING provider denial -> pause same identity; recovery wake-only; no extra budget/reservation/dispatch
MANUAL unknown capacity and weekly advisory preserved; hard provider denial wins; CONTROLLED_AUTO disabled
review/result PASS never acceptance/authority; status-only never dispatch/invoke; proposal authority_granted=false
rev5 lane + AUTO-IMP-001 DAG foundation; no invented dependency on002; no ProgramV1 authority/old quota inheritance
deep immutability/input unchanged/serialization roundtrip; no side effects; no actual repo HEAD dependency
test_plan.cross_targeted: python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/automation/test_authorization.py tests/automation/test_state_machine.py tests/automation/test_contracts.py tests/automation/test_repository_snapshot.py tests/automation/test_orchestration.py tests/automation/test_execution_capacity.py -q
test_plan.order: Impacted subset until clean -> one complete targeted -> one cross-targeted -> one final full when warranted -> git diff --check -> exact scope/protected Git blob proof
test_plan.WORK_tests_now: NO_IMPLEMENTATION_TEST_RUN; compilation contract and deterministic progression guards only

No implementation/authority/controller/runtime side effects beyond future exact scoped grant.
